description: The Powerviz Network Graph is a visual representation of objects (called nodes or vertices) and the relationships or connections (called edges or links) between them. Its primary purpose is to illustrate how different entities are related or interact with one another. The Powerviz advanced Network Graph includes features such as clustering, highlighting the relation between the nodes, fill pattern, 30+ color palette, conditional formatting, shape customization, line customization, directional arrow, and many more. Check out the live demo here. To access all the advanced settings features, click the gear "⚙️" icon in the top-right corner. Key Feature Highlights: Line Options: Customize the link between the nodes and add different styles and colors. Node Shape: Customize the shape of the nodes by selecting from various shapes, and icons or upload your own. Labels: Apply data labels to enhance user experience. Display a combination of categories, values, and percentages of the total. Data Colors: Offers 30+ color palettes including color-blind safe mode for better accessibility. Fill Pattern: Create patterns by selecting from a diverse range of options or upload your own. Ranking: Filter out Top/Bottom N by each level.
